items.label: nVent press release: nVent to Acquire Maverick Power (08-24-2026)
items.signal_prefix: nVent entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Maveric

set.signal: nVent entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Maverick Power, a North American provider of engineered power distribution and infrastructure solutions for data centers, including low-voltage switchgear and switchboards, medium-voltage switchgear, integrated modular solutions, and services. Maverick Power is headquartered in McKinney, Texas, has approximately 900 employees in Texas and Arizona and estimated 2026 revenues of approximately $700 million; the release says the business has a strong backlog and future demand visibility. The deal adds a power distribution platform complementing nVent's data center offerings and expands its offerings for new power architectures and system-level solutions and services for data centers. Chair and CEO Beth Wozniak: Maverick Power 'brings strong power distribution expertise and broadens our offerings to data center customers'. Closing is expected in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to customary closing conditions including regulatory approval.

items.reason: EPS-accretion expectation is deal economics tied to the purchase price/financing, not an operating fact of the acquired business (SKILL §2: acquisition operating facts only, never price); rest verified verbatim
items.evidence: nVent expects the acquisition to be accretive to adjusted earnings per share in the first year following completion of the transaction.

items.label: Vertiv press release: Vertiv Announces Agreement to Acquire UtilityInnovation (09-02-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Vertiv (through its wholly-owned subsidiary Vertiv Corporati

set.signal: Vertiv (through its wholly-owned subsidiary Vertiv Corporation) entered into an agreement and plan of merger to acquire Utility Innovation Holdings, Inc., operating as UtilityInnovation Group (UIG), a provider of microgrid solutions, advanced power controls and behind-the-meter power architecture design for data centers. Operating scope added: microgrid controls, onsite generation and energy storage orchestration, microgrid-specific switchgear and behind-the-meter power architecture, extending Vertiv's power and cooling portfolio upstream to the grid interconnect ('from grid interconnect to chip'), independent of any single generation technology or supplier. UIG brings design and delivery of microgrid systems for AI data center operators across the United States and Europe, a proprietary controls platform and pre-engineered microgrid switchgear that orchestrate multiple power sources in real time with the critical power train, and pre-validated reference designs for grid-connected, bridge-to-grid and islanded sites. CEO Gio Albertazzi: 'With UIG, we anticipate extending that portfolio upstream to the utility interconnect and onsite power sources, creating a coordinated architecture from source to chip'; Vertiv expects the capabilities to help data center operators secure power faster as grid constraints increasingly limit AI infrastructure deployment.

items.reason: remove enricher meta-note ('Purchase price and earnout terms are not captured.') that is not a statement from the source; all other content verified
